t: Milwaukee 25mm Hex Shank PZ2 Shockwave Impact Screwdriver Bits are engineered for heavy-duty fastening tasks, making them an essential for professional tradespeople working on demanding construction sites or in workshop environments. These durable impact driver bits feature WEARGUARDTIP technology for enhanced wear resistance and a precise fit, ensuring longevity. The optimised SHOCKZONE geometry flexes to absorb impacts, significantly reducing stress and breakages. Manufactured from custom-engineered steel, these 25mm PZ2 bits offer superior resistance to high-torque impact driving, providing reliable performance for any impact driver application.
b: Suitable for Power Screwdrivers with Impact Mode
